posts.author: Ladon_Here
posts.body:
My friends call me Ladon(so you can call me that too)
. I must admit,
I had been considering joining the Forum for a while now,
because I stand to gain a lot of help from the many members of the Group, I am
HONOURED
to be a part of the forum now and that I will be of help in the forum from today onwards.
That aside, I have a question,
​
I have really been eyeing working with RPG Maker 2000 or 2003 for my first free projects, but I would also like RPG Maker XP as I Progress, For the third, I want either RPG Maker VX Ace or RPG Maker MV, your opinions would be very much appreciated. Some advice for working with RPG Maker 2000/2003 would similarly be very much appreciated.
Thank you all in advance and I look forward to your support
.

posts.author: TeiRaven
posts.body:
Welcome aboard, Ladon! We're glad to have you here!
If you want to try all the RPG Makers out because it sounds like fun, you should absolutely go for it! But it's not necessary to start with the oldest engines and work your way forward. I agree with Trid: focus the engine that you're overall most interested in, because the differences between them can be huge.
My favorite is XP, followed by MZ. Personally, I hated the mapping system in VX/A and MV, I felt it was very restrictive, but your mileage may vary!
